Personnel are strategically positioned to monitor and maintain the traffic situation.

RUN FREE, TIKTOK 🙏

 Bach Project PH mourned the death of rescued dog “Tiktok” from a car accident on Sunday, Sept. 7.

“We don’t know how to put this into words. Today, we lost Tiktok in a tragic accident while she was in foster care,” the local animal welfare group said in a social media post.

The group reported that Tiktok slipped out, ran, and was hit by a car. “It was so sudden, and even now, it feels impossible to accept,” they added.

@villageman9999 
⚡️The HIRE Act Just Lit the Fuse.
Was aware of its coming. but people start trolling you, the moment you voice out. 
So here’s my 2 words.
Global outsourcing? Now officially under fire. 💣
📜 A 25% tax on all U.S. outsourcing payments.
No deductions. No loopholes. Just cold, calculated pressure.
Let’s be clear
This isn’t a tweak, it’s a direct strike on the very foundation of the global digital supply chain.
💼 U.S. corporates now face a brutal choice
•Pay extra to go offshore,
•Or start building domestically fast.

🌍 This hits hard in Asia, Europe, Canada, India,
It echoes in the Philippines.
It rattles delivery centers in Vietnam, Poland, and LATAM.
And it screams through global equity markets where service majors are priced for perfection.

📉 What’s at stake?
•Millions of jobs
•Cross-border tech flows
•Margins of Fortune 500s
•Trust in globalization itself
But here’s the twist,
💥 The bill doesn’t just punish, it shifts power.

🧱 A new wall is going up between nations and networks.
🌐 The “global village” is being redrawn, one tariff at a time.

And while 🇺🇸 U.S. talks domestic workforce uplift.
The real question is, Who controls the future of talent?

🇺🇸 This Act is designed to bring jobs back home, forcing companies to invest in American talent, not just global cost cutting.
📈 It aims to rebuild domestic supply chains, strengthen the middle class, and reduce reliance on foreign labor for critical tech and service roles.

Because this isn’t just economics anymore,
It’s tech sovereignty, digital nationalism, and workforce warfare.
The age of frictionless outsourcing is ending.
The new game? Strategic alliances, policy firewalls, and skill resilience.

So buckle up, before it hits hard
